name: PAT_SMS_TO_MEMBER
description: Text messages sent to the member via Tapestry Auto Actions.

columns.name: PAT_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the patient record for this row. This column is frequently used to link to the PATIENT table.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: SENT_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The UTC date and time when a text message was sent to the member.

columns.name: PHONE_NUMBER
columns.description: The phone number to which the text message was sent.

columns.name: NOTE_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the note record of the SMS message sent to the member.

columns.name: SMS_SMARTTEXT_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the SmartText record used as the SMS message sent to the member.

columns.name: SMS_SMARTTEXT_ID_SMARTTEXT_NAME
columns.description: The name of the SmartText record.

columns.name: SMS_SETTING_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the Hello World communication template (HST) for the SMS sent to the member.

columns.name: FROM_USER_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the user who sent the text message to the member.

columns.name: FROM_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.
